faqs.question: What is the formula to convert Celsius to Fahrenheit?
What is 37°C in Fahrenheit?
faqs.answer: 37°C = 98.6°F — this is normal human body temperature.

faqs.question: At what temperature are Celsius and Fahrenheit the same?
faqs.answer: At exactly -40 degrees. Both scales read -40 at that point.

faqs.question: What is room temperature in Fahrenheit?
faqs.answer: Room temperature is typically 20–22°C, which equals 68–71.6°F.

faqs.question: How do I roughly convert Celsius to Fahrenheit in my head?
faqs.answer: Double the Celsius value and add 30. E.g. 20°C → 40+30 = 70°F (actual: 68°F). Quick and close enough.
